# Psalm 26 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Of-David. Judge-me, YHWH, for I in-my-integrity have-walked, and-in-YHWH I-have-trusted; I-shall-not slip.

**2** Examine-me, YHWH, and-test-me; refine my-kidneys [inner being] and-my-heart.

**3** For Your-steadfast-love [is] before my-eyes, and-I-walk in-Your-truth.

**4** I-do-not sit with men-of falsehood, and-with the-concealed I-do-not go.

**5** I-hate the-assembly of-evildoers, and-with the-wicked I-do-not sit.

**6** I-wash my-hands in-innocence and-go-around Your-altar, YHWH,

**7** to-make-heard the-voice of-thanksgiving and-to-recount all Your-wonders.

**8** YHWH, I-love the-dwelling of-Your-house and-the-place where-Your-glory tabernacles.

**9** Do-not gather my-soul with-sinners, and-my-life with-men of-blood,

**10** in-whose hands [is] a-scheme, and-whose right-hand [is] full of-bribes.

**11** But-I in-my-integrity walk; redeem-me and-be-gracious to-me.

**12** My-foot stands on-level-ground; in-the-assemblies I-will-bless YHWH.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **26:6**: 'Wash my hands in innocence' — a ritual purification gesture before approaching the altar. The phrase became proverbial (cf. Pilate in Matt 27:24).

— EMET
